data.narrative:
Simbe Robotics is a Series C robotics and manufacturing company that has raised over $100M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparable universe of 9 private and 1 public company in the robotics sector at similar or adjacent stages, including peers such as Exotec, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, and Hadrian.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method, anchoring to the $100M raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C advancement, yields $170M. The peer-median method examines seven same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with a median valuation of $1.6B and a range of $1.0B to $2.0B, directly implying $1.6B for Simbe. The disparity between these approaches reflects the wide band of outcomes evident in the robotics funding market at this stage.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $144M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $910M. The wide spread reflects two material uncertainties: (1) the applicability of peer multiples derived from companies at varied stages—some Series B, others Series D—to a Series C-stage firm, and (2) whether Simbe's operational traction and market position more closely align with the lower end (stage-progression anchor) or the upper end (peer median). Incremental clarity on revenue scale, customer concentration, and unit economics would narrow this band materially.
